title: Cross-region quarantine + gradual backfill for hosted API deployments
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: We continue to see risk during cross-region upgrades where an unexpected model or runtime interaction in a single region causes amplified error rates as traffic is shifted. Current blue/green and canary flows lack a lightweight quarantine stage and automated backfill that limits blast radius while preserving capacity efficiency.

Goal: Implement a quarantine + gradual backfill pattern for hosted API deployments that: (1) quarantines new model/runtime variants in a small isolated cohort in each region; (2) uses SLO-driven gates to progressively open capacity and shift traffic; (3) provides an automated backfill path to fall back capacity to the previous LTS variant without full rollback; and (4) integrates with Console dashboards and runtime health checks for real-time decisions.

Deliverables: design doc + sequence diagram, feature flags for quarantine mode, rollout controller changes (policy engine hooks), runtime metric hooks (per-variant token error, tail latency, model quality signal), Console gating UI, automated rollback/backfill runbook, test-suite for staging and chaos runs.
acceptance_criteria: Quarantine cohort can be enabled per-region and per-customer tier via rollout policy
Automated gates evaluate error-rate, p95 latency, and token-exactness model checks and decide progression within configured thresholds
Traffic backfill reduces new-variant share to 0% in under 30s without dropping overall throughput and without reconfiguring DNS
Rollout events, gate decisions, and backfill actions are visible in Console with links to the exact runtime traces
Staging run with synthetic traffic and failure injection shows <5% failed progressions and correct rollback behavior
updates: 2026-03-01: Ticket created after on-call postmortem; initial scoping with SRE and Runtime teams. Identified need for cohort isolation without cold-start amplification.

2026-03-03: Design sketch completed — quarantine cohort implemented as lightweight overlay that pins a fraction of capacity per-region to new variant; existing blue/green remains available as full fallback.
2026-03-05: Prototype rollout-controller patch (internal branch) adds 'quarantine_percent' and 'backfill_thresholds' fields; unit tests added for policy evaluation logic.

2026-03-07: Staging run executed across eu-west and us-east with 10% quarantine cohort; observed that p95 latency for new variant spikes by 20% under prefix-cache warmup — added KV pre-warm step to mitigation list.
2026-03-09: Design review with PM and Console owners; agreed to expose gate thresholds and manual 'fast-forward' override in Console. Security signoff not required for config-only change.

2026-03-10: PR opened: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3419 (rollout-controller) and github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/762 (runtime cohort sampling). Next: add backfill orchestration and e2e staging tests.
